title: Derived tensor notation
statement:
Fix a scheme $Y$ and a commutative ring $A$, and use the small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with its constant sheaf of rings $A_Y$, the abelian category of $A_Y$-modules and $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ as defined there. A complex $P$
of $A_Y$-modules is *K-flat* if tensoring it with every acyclic complex
preserves acyclicity, that is, it is K-flat in the sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex] for the ringed site $(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_Y)$. For complexes $K_1,K_2$ of $A_Y$-modules, choose a
quasi-isomorphism $P\to K_1$ with $P$ K-flat (one exists by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]) and define

$$
 K_1\otimes_A^L K_2=P\otimes_A K_2
$$

(the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] over $A_Y$) regarded as an object of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. For a ring map $A\to B$ and a complex $K_1$,
write $K_1\otimes_A^L B$ for derived tensor with the constant $B_Y$-module, regarded as an $A_Y$-module by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] along the induced map $A_Y\to B_Y$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category whose tensor
product is additive and which has functorial flat resolutions, and let $Y$ be a scheme with
small pro-étale site $Y_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The *derived tensor
product*

$$
-\otimes^{\mathrm L}-\colon D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\times D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

is the tensor product of the monoidal structure of [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal] on the
derived category of $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$, equipped with the sheaf tensor
product of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure].

Concretely, a complex $P$ of sheaves is *K-flat* if tensoring it with every acyclic complex
preserves acyclicity. For complexes $K_1,K_2$, choose a quasi-isomorphism $P\to K_1$ with
$P$ K-flat; then

$$
 K_1\otimes^{\mathrm L} K_2=P\otimes K_2 .
$$

For $\mathcal A$ the category of modules over a commutative ring $A$ (so that complexes are
complexes of $A_Y$-modules) this is written $K_1\otimes_A^{\mathrm L}K_2$ in
$D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$. For a ring map $A\to B$ and a complex $K_1$, write
$K_1\otimes_A^{\mathrm L} B$ for the derived tensor product with the constant $B_Y$-module.

proof.text:
The small pro-étale site is essentially small, so $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$ is a
Grothendieck abelian category, and with the sheaf tensor product it is closed symmetric
monoidal [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed]. It has functorial flat resolutions because
$\mathcal A$ does: the sheafified free objects on representables, tensored with a flat
separator of $\mathcal A$, form a flat separator. Hence [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal] applies,
and its derived tensor product is computed by replacing either argument by a K-flat
resolution, which gives the concrete description.
